notes: Daily run (Friday), 17 brands, A$1,000–2,000. 75 models carried; 58 deals at least 3% under benchmark.

Feed sweep: 27 of 46 feeds read; cut by the 8-minute deadline: prideandpinion, jura, watchnation, watchgecko, seriouswatches, uhrinstinkt, montredo, zeitauktion, paulin, anordain, underd0g, unimatic, define, gregory, kalmar, zaeger, swisswatchdealer, christiesnz, meistersinger.

Tracked listings refreshed from feeds: 1149; 7 newly out of stock or delisted (marked removed); 9 back in stock; 0 new in-band feed listings attached to tracked models by reference; 16 price drops of 5%+ vs stored AUD price (indicative).
Only listings refreshed by this run's feed sweep are marked active; the rest are unverified (page not re-read today).

No web-search research pass, vanished-listing re-checks, photo phase or auction search was run (feed sweep and merge only, as on 8 and 9 Nov); new models were not discovered. Chrono24, eBay and WatchCharts are known blockers. Status partial for that reason.
Sold prices in sold[] are last asking prices, not hammer prices. Brand notes and style counts are carried from the previous run.

brands.name: anOrdain
brands.note: Only Model 1/2 enamel pieces surface; pre-owned asks USD 2,200-2,930 and new builds GBP 1,840-1,980 ex VAT on a 2031 waitlist, all above the AUD 2,000 band.

brands.name: Christopher Ward
brands.note: Plenty of in-band pre-owned Twelve (36/38/40) and C63 Sealander Automatic on Reddit at USD 800-1,200 (AUD 1,150-1,720), plus new C63 at T+T Shop USD 1,150; most pre-owned dealer stock (SeriousWatches, Right Time, Kibble) is sold. 127 in-band feed rows not matched to a carried model.

brands.name: Frederique Constant
brands.note: FC-303 Classics Index Automatic is the in-band workhorse: new US AD ~USD1,165-1,695 and Reddit pre-owned USD575-1,000 (AUD 820-1,430). 94 in-band feed rows not matched to a carried model.

brands.name: IWC
brands.note: Vintage Pellaton dress automatics (cal. 852/8531/8541, refs 803A/804A/814A/810A) are the only in-band IWC supply at US$650-1,950 on r/Watchexchange; modern pilots/Ingenieurs all US$2.9k+ and the Jumbo 3303 quartz is ~US$19k. 1 in-band feed rows not matched to a carried model.

brands.name: King Seiko
brands.note: Dominated by vintage 45KS/56KS Reddit posts (USD 300-950, mostly below band) plus KSK SPB279-family new at ~USD 1,700 / JPY 220-242k (in band, AUD ~2,000-2,400) and a pre-owned SPB391 at USD 1,480 (AUD ~2,120).

brands.name: Longines
brands.note: Reddit is rich in in-band dress Longines (Master Collection 38.5/Big Date/Small Seconds, Flagship, Annual Calendar at USD1,195-1,800); new Conquest 38 is out of band (USD2,400 / AUD3,550). 170 in-band feed rows not matched to a carried model.

brands.name: MeisterSinger
brands.note: No secondary-market listings on WatchRecon; Neo 36 new at Teddy Baldassarre sale USD999 (AUD 1,430) is the best in-band find, plus Neo Q quartz (GBP995) and Phanero PH307G (AUD1,932); AD automatic prices are otherwise USD2,499+. 2 in-band feed rows not matched to a carried model.

brands.name: NOMOS Glashütte
brands.note: Club Campus 36/38 is the in-band sweet spot: many new Wristler DE dealer pieces at EUR 1,245-1,469 (AUD ~2,000-2,350) and Reddit pre-owned at USD 1,295-1,550; Ludwig 38 (234) added as a new in-band dress model. 2 in-band feed rows not matched to a carried model.

brands.name: Omega
brands.note: Deep in-band supply: Constellation C-Case 168.0056 at US$740-1,290, Geneve/De Ville vintage at US$500-1,175 and Wristler EUR 1,000-1,400; Constellation pie-pan 168.005 mostly US$2.4-2.8k (above band). 154 in-band feed rows not matched to a carried model.

brands.name: Orient
brands.note: Orient Star dress models sit squarely in band new (M45 small second EUR 913-1,239, M34 semi-skeleton EUR 999 / GBP 1,000, moon phase GBP 973-EUR 1,959, Avant-Garde skeleton EUR 1,032-1,258); pre-owned Orient listings on Reddit are mostly far below band. 30 in-band feed rows not matched to a carried model.

brands.name: Oris
brands.note: Big Crown Pointer Date 40mm (7741/7785/7798) is heavily traded on Reddit at USD 890-1,500 (AUD 1,270-2,140), new retail USD 2,400+; ProPilot Big Day Date and earlier-ref Pointer Dates also present; divers excluded by style filter. 5 in-band feed rows not matched to a carried model.

brands.name: Paulin
brands.note: Thin secondary market: a Mara on Reddit (USD 975, in-band) and sold/old Neo listings at GBP 330-450. 3 in-band feed rows not matched to a carried model.

brands.name: Seiko
brands.note: Presage dress models carry the band: SPB463 new at AUD 1,550-1,670 at AU retailers, SARX055/SARX029/SARX105 pre-owned USD 975-1,200 (AUD 1,400-1,720); most other Seiko listings seen were divers/field/chrono and were filtered out. 710 in-band feed rows not matched to a carried model.

brands.name: Sinn
brands.note: 556 I/A and 104 St Sa dominate in-band supply via Reddit (USD 900-1,750) plus WatchBuys new 556 I USD 1,490; 434 found only as ladies variants without in-band listings.

brands.name: Studio Underd0g
brands.note: 02SERIES Gen2 new at T+T Shop USD 1,200 (AUD 1,718) and pre-owned Red L0lly / Steffany Blue on Reddit at ~USD 950-1,000; Fears Mim0sa asks USD 1,199-1,750; 01SERIES chronos excluded.

brands.name: Tissot
brands.note: Core models sit below band pre-owned (USD 450-750) while AU retail via Myer puts PRX/Gentleman/Le Locle/Ballade at AUD 1,220-1,800; added PRX Titanium 38 and Gentleman Open Heart as new in-band models. 520 in-band feed rows not matched to a carried model.

brands.name: Tudor
brands.note: Prince Date 72000/72033 and Prince Oysterdate 74033 sit in band privately (US$850-1,500, EUR 980) while dealers ask EUR 2,250-2,550; ladies Princess 92413/92313 at Wristler EUR 1,350-1,750. 2 in-band feed rows not matched to a carried model.
